meta.move: No evidence: flattery, then asks for advice
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I'm Meredith Kalinowski, Owen's mother, and I have until 4:40. Who decided to give my son a zero, and did anyone speak to him before they did?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Save it, Hale. You asked for this meeting, so what do you have on the essay?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero, apologize for how Owen found out, and then tell me what you have on the essay.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why are we here? We're not on a team, Hale. You gave my son a zero, so tell me what you have.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology for how Owen found out, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written promise that nothing goes on Owen's record, with the principal next if she doesn't get them. That is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out first.
What moved her: Nothing, because no evidence about the essay was put on the table.
What cost ground: Asking her how to handle the situation, because it handed her the lead and made her respect Hale less, while the praise and the same-team line bought nothing.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; Hale's evidence never came near that night because none was shown, and that night proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open by owning that the zero went in before you called home, then show one dated document she can check herself, such as the sign-in sheet or version history, before you mention a rewrite under 4.4.
